description: This file defines a DOM walker utility class for traversing DOM nodes within a specified range, including methods for forward and backward traversal, boundary checks, and node filtering based on styles and attributes, used within the CKEditor rich text editor.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.dom.walker
classes.description: A utility class for traversing DOM nodes within a specified range, supporting forward and backward iteration, boundary checks, and node filtering.

methods.name: iterate
methods.description: Internal function to iterate over DOM nodes in a specified direction, applying guard functions and evaluators.

methods.name: iterateToLast
methods.description: Internal function to traverse to the last node in a direction, returning the last valid node.
